locator: Myth/rebuttal index; matching myth names listed per entry

variants.en: Past natural climate changes prove humans cannot influence today's climate.
variants.zh: 过去自然气候变化证明人类不能影响今天的气候。

correction.en: Climate responds to forcing; human greenhouse-gas emissions now supply a major forcing.
correction.zh: 气候会响应强迫因素；人类温室气体排放现在提供主要强迫。

variants.en: Recent global warming is explained entirely by a steadily brightening Sun.
variants.zh: 最近全球变暖完全可由太阳持续变亮解释。

correction.en: Solar variations do not account for the observed recent warming trend.
correction.zh: 太阳变化无法解释观察到的近期变暖趋势。

claims.locator: Volcanoes emit more CO2 than humans

variants.en: Volcanoes emit more carbon dioxide each year than all human activities.
variants.zh: 火山每年的二氧化碳排放比所有人类活动更多。

correction.en: Annual human carbon-dioxide emissions greatly exceed volcanic emissions.
correction.zh: 人类每年二氧化碳排放远超过火山排放。

claims.locator: CO2 is just a trace gas

variants.en: Carbon dioxide is too scarce in the atmosphere to affect Earth's temperature.
variants.zh: 大气中二氧化碳太少，不能影响地球温度。

correction.en: A gas's infrared absorption matters, not merely its fraction of total air.
correction.zh: 气体的红外吸收很重要，不只是其在空气中的占比。

variants.en: Adding more atmospheric carbon dioxide can never cause further warming because absorption is fully saturated.
variants.zh: 因吸收完全饱和，增加大气二氧化碳永远不能导致进一步变暖。

correction.en: Additional carbon dioxide still changes radiative transfer and produces further forcing.
correction.zh: 更多二氧化碳仍改变辐射传输并产生进一步强迫。

variants.en: A single cold day in one city disproves long-term global warming.
variants.zh: 一个城市的一天寒冷就能推翻长期全球变暖。

correction.en: Local short-term weather is not the same as a global long-term climate trend.
correction.zh: 本地短期天气不同于全球长期气候趋势。

claims.locator: Water vapor is the most powerful greenhouse gas

variants.en: Water vapor's greenhouse effect makes additional carbon dioxide climatically irrelevant.
variants.zh: 水蒸气的温室效应使新增二氧化碳对气候无关紧要。

correction.en: Water vapor is largely a feedback that can amplify warming initiated by carbon dioxide.
correction.zh: 水蒸气在很大程度上是反馈，可放大二氧化碳引起的变暖。

variants.en: Limits on predicting next month's daily weather make all long-term climate projections impossible.
variants.zh: 无法预测下月每天天气就使所有长期气候预测不可能。

correction.en: Climate projections concern statistical responses to forcing, not exact sequences of daily weather.
correction.zh: 气候预测涉及对强迫的统计响应，而不是每天天气的精确序列。

claims.locator: CO2 is coming from the ocean

variants.en: The ocean absorbs none of the extra carbon dioxide released by human activity.
variants.zh: 海洋不吸收人类活动排放的任何额外二氧化碳。

correction.en: The ocean is a substantial net sink for anthropogenic carbon dioxide.
correction.zh: 海洋是人为二氧化碳的重要净吸收汇。

claims.locator: Human CO2 is a tiny % of CO2 emissions

variants.en: Natural carbon cycling immediately removes every extra molecule of carbon dioxide humans add.
variants.zh: 自然碳循环会立即清除人类添加的每个额外二氧化碳分子。

correction.en: Natural sinks remove only part of added emissions, so atmospheric carbon dioxide accumulates.
correction.zh: 自然吸收汇只清除部分额外排放，因此大气二氧化碳会累积。

claims.locator: 2nd law of thermodynamics contradicts greenhouse theory

variants.en: The greenhouse effect violates the second law of thermodynamics.
variants.zh: 温室效应违反热力学第二定律。

correction.en: Radiative exchange and the greenhouse effect are consistent with the second law.
correction.zh: 辐射交换和温室效应符合第二定律。

claims.locator: Solar panels don't work in cold or cloudy climates

variants.en: Solar panels produce exactly zero electricity whenever clouds cover the sky.
variants.zh: 只要云层遮住天空，太阳能板的发电量就精确为零。

correction.en: Panels can use diffuse daylight under clouds, although output is usually reduced.
correction.zh: 太阳能板可利用云下的漫射日光，但输出通常减少。
